stories.title: Tier ensemble (logit/prob averaging of small+mid+large) on mixed-SNR
stories.evidence: NO-WIN (honestly recorded). 3-seed mixed-SNR: ensemble(s+m+l)=0.569+-.042@586K (-0.055 vs large), ensemble(mid+large)=0.586+-.049@577K (-0.038). Ensemble WORSE than single large at higher cost — weak-member drag (small/mid weak in noise), consistent with complementarity absence. REPRODUCIBILITY_FINDINGS.md 8-2m added. imp_ensemble.csv saved.
acceptanceCriteria: Soft-vote ensemble (mean of softmax over small+mid+large) evaluated on the SAME mixed-SNR test, 3 seeds, using saved final_models
Report ensemble macro-F1 mean+-std AND cost (sum of 3 tiers = 586K) vs single large (0.624@524K)
Result recorded in REPRODUCIBILITY_FINDINGS.md regardless of win/no-win; state whether it beats large within seed noise

stories.title: Magnitude/structured pruning + fine-tune of large (does pruning improve, not just shrink?)
stories.evidence: NO-WIN on accuracy, with CONTROL. 3-seed mixed: dense 0.624 / p30 0.624 / p50 0.625 / p70 0.630 (all within std). CONTROL dense+12ep-ft(no prune)=0.623, per-seed swing identical to pruned (s42 +.035/s1 -.031/s7 -.006) => gains are extra-training noise, NOT pruning. User hypothesis unsupported. BUT 70% prune (156K nonzero) keeps F1 => REDUNDANCY confirmed (reinforces capacity story: redundant capacity buys robustness; 9K-from-scratch collapses). REPRODUCIBILITY 8-2m, fig_pruning.png, imp_prune.csv + imp_prune_control.csv.
acceptanceCriteria: Prune large (global magnitude 30/50/70%) then fine-tune on clean; evaluate pruned-large on mixed-SNR, 3 seeds
Report pruned macro-F1 mean+-std + effective nonzero params vs dense large (0.624); test the user's hypothesis 'pruning removes redundancy and can improve performance'
Recorded in REPRODUCIBILITY_FINDINGS.md regardless of outcome (incl. if pruning only matches or degrades)

stories.title: Noise-augmented training of large (standard noise-robustness booster)
stories.evidence: WIN (the only method that genuinely improves accuracy). noise-aug + noisy-val selection: 0.651+-.007 vs clean-large 0.624+-.028 = +0.027, 2/3 seeds improve (s42 +.063,s1 +.024,s7 -.006), variance cut 4x (.028->.007). clean-val variant weaker (0.633,+0.009 within noise) due to train/val noise mismatch. CAVEAT: protocol change (model sees noise in training, not clean-only); needs deployment-matched val. val noise seed 333 != test 222 (no leakage). REPRODUCIBILITY 8-2m method 3/3b, imp_noiseaug.csv + imp_noiseaug_nv.csv, saved cnn_large_noiseaug_nv_s*.pt.
acceptanceCriteria: Train large with AWGN augmentation (SNR range incl. clean) then evaluate on the SAME mixed-SNR test, 3 seeds
Report aug-trained large macro-F1 mean+-std vs clean-trained large (0.624); clearly note this is a DIFFERENT training protocol (not clean-only)
Recorded in REPRODUCIBILITY_FINDINGS.md; state protocol-change caveat explicitly
